messages.content: Write only an optional comparison for a factual UN decision record. Compare the delivered national statement with the delivered clause of the adopted resolution. Identify each actor and connect both sources only if they support a specific useful distinction. Keep a delegation's interpretation separate from the Council's action. Use only the supplied text. If there is no directly supported comparison, return exactly NONE. Otherwise write one or two sentences and at most 42 words.

{"adopted_clause": "Paragraph 11 asks the Secretary-General to continue regular country-specific reporting on the humanitarian situation and response, including famine and food-insecurity risk.
